games.description: Four rounds of screenshot trivia with Twitch chat, from tiny early images to larger pictures and increasingly competitive guesses. Host advantage, ambiguous screenshots and repeated promises of one last round become part of the contest.
games.title: Chat Guess Games

games.description: A solo playthrough of gieko’s short kidnapping horror game. Sark gets an early bad ending, restarts to recover the seven borrowed games and reaches the news-report ending after the final closet search.
games.title: Kidnappers

games.description: Sark tries the Twitch-integrated anomaly surveillance game, configures the reporting commands and tests the gallery cameras. The session ends after chat’s reports fail to work reliably.
games.title: Look Closer!

games.description: Sark searches an industrial maze for his cat, pushes away pursuing enemies and maps the route to the scattered ghosts. Finding the cat leads to another hostile area and a final death.
games.title: Neurose Neurones

games.description: Sark fights through a surreal wartime landscape, manages scarce ammunition and searches houses, trenches and a plane wreck for keys. A blocked route and one final search end the unfinished run.
games.title: Quadrillion

games.description: Sark follows a sinister videotape through slow corridors, candle clues and increasingly strange rooms.
games.title: The Cursed Tape

games.description: Sark investigates a dark town, searches for a church key and tries to outmaneuver the creature stalking its streets.
games.title: The Hope
